title: 2.0 copy the docs contradict: six in-app strings still describe 1.x or the wrong place
description:
Found 2026-09-28 by the Cubric Studio Docs 2.0 rewrite (docs repo card MPI-19), which verified every docs page against master. Each string below is user-facing, ships in 2.0 as it stands, and now contradicts both the code and the new docs. All six re-confirmed on master 08a1ccab1 (2026-09-29).

1. js/data/modelConstants/models.js:1051, FLUX.2 Klein 4B description (Model Library detail panel): says run Inpaint with the prompt left empty and the object is gone in about four seconds. The 2.0 inpaint op does NOTHING on an empty prompt (commandRegistry.js inpaint help ~611-658, promptRequired: true). Users read this tile first.
2. services/agentLoop.mjs:1632, agent system prompt: 'a helpful assistant built into Cubric Vision'. Cosmo can name the app by its old name in chat.
3. js/components/Compounds/MpiNewProject/MpiNewProject.js:40, New Project hint: 'Documents/Cubric Vision/Projects'. 2.0 renames the folder to Documents/Cubric Studio on first boot (routes/shared.js _getDocumentsFolder); a comment at :39 already flags this as pending the version bump.
4. js/managers/hotkeyRegistry.js:424, radialMenu.toggle description: 'Hold for Gallery, Projects, Flows and your latest workspace'. The radial holds Gallery, Models, Flows, Latest Workspace (js/shell/navigation.js _userRadialItems, MPI-811). Shows in the in-app Hotkeys panel.
5. js/services/cloudExecutor.js:62 (NO_KEY) and :63 (NO_PROFILE): 'Settings → Remote → Language Models'. Remote is its own top-level panel beside Settings (MpiRemote, js/shell/projectUI.js:94), not inside Settings.
6. js/components/Organisms/MpiVideoControlBar/MpiVideoControlBar.js:198, fullscreen button tooltip 'Fullscreen (F)'. F is focus mode (hotkeyRegistry.js:111) and F11 is window fullscreen (:733); no key toggles the player's fullscreen. Either bind a key or drop '(F)'.

Internal only (no user sees them, fix if convenient): docs/playbooks/add-flow/README.md:9-12,132-134 and the js/data/flowsRegistry.js header still call the Flow Library dev-gated (lifted in MPI-589); js/services/generationService.js:37 says TWO-LANE dispatch, there are three lanes since MPI-851.

Also owed to the docs, decided at the 2.0 release cut (MPI-708 D1): which 1.x versions can update to 2.0 in place, and what a user who skipped the 1.5.1 bridge downloads. The docs Installation page holds a TODO for it.

When done, tell the docs session (repo C:\AI\Mpi\Cubric Studio (Docs), card MPI-19): it resumes from its handoff and re-checks these six against the docs.
